verses.text: Yaku' i Paulus, poposuu' ni Kristus Yesus gause ia potoo Alaata'ala men Pansalamatkon i kita, ka' uga' gause ia potoo i Kristus Yesus men pimpu'uanna upa men ooskononta.

Bona i Timotius, men yaku' popo'anakmo na sa'angu' kaparasaya'an! Sulano kaporean, lino-linoan, ka' koratongan men ringkat na Alaata'ala Tama na surugaa, ka' i Kristus Yesus, Tumpunta, surioon na tutuo'om.

Kikira'ku kada' i koo no'omo na kota Efesus, koi men yaku' rorongikonmo na ko'oom tempo i yaku' nomae' na libutan Makedonia. Gause na Efesus isian toropii mian men mengelelekon pisiso' men sala', ka' i koo tio mongkokundakon i raaya'a dako' i raaya'a mimisiso'kon men sala'.

Bantilkon na ko'ona i raaya'a se' aliamomo' mamarasaya uma-uman ka' alia muntundun susunganna puli men sian kapupulanna. Giigii' iya'a tongko' mantakakon poogagaian, ka' sian munsunsungkon sagiana Alaata'ala men sida inti'ion kalu i kita parasaya na Ko'ona.
Panduungna bantilingku kani'i kada' mian minginti'i molingu'kon simbaya'na tia polingu' men ringkat na noa men molinas, noa men minginti'i upa men kana' ka' men sala', ka' tuutuu' parasaya na Tumpu.
Kasee isian i raaya'a men ningiliaskonmo men koiya'a. Raaya'a muntundun men sian mingkaliangan.
Raaya'a mingkira' kada' sida bo pimisiso'kon ukum Torat, kasee men tundunonna kabai se' men kakatkononna ka' popo'inti'ikonon sian inti'ionna i raaya'a.
Kita poto inti'i se' ukum Torat iya'a pore kalu salankonon koi men tuutuu'na.

Tio inti'ionta se' ukum Torat mase niwawau taasi' bona mian men kana', kasee bona mian men mingilintuani ukum, mian men ba'idek a gau'na, men sian malolo' na Tumpu, men dosaon, men sian monsoosa' Tumpu, men tongko' mingkira'kon upa-upa na dunia, men mampapatei tama kabai se' sinana, men mampapatei simbaya'na,

men mogora', men pookikira'i simbaya' moro'one, men mamangan mian ka' mentetende'kon, men mimborek, men basumpa' kasee borek, ka' giigii' mian men mangawawau upa men sian sintutu' tia pisiso' men kana'.
Pisiso' men kana' iya'a isian na Lele Pore men ringkat na Alaata'ala men kuasaan ka' men tio tunde'on. Lele Pore iya'a nipokau na ingku' bo lelekononku.
Yaku' basukuur ni Kristus Yesus, Tumpunta, men nompopomoonggor i yaku', gause Ia nimiile' se' i yaku' sida ooskonon. Ia patukokonmo i yaku' bo pingilimang palimangon-Na,

mau mune' mbaripian malia' mingiroki Tumpu, mengerepai mian, ka' soropu'on. Mau koiya'a, Alaata'ala nantarai i yaku' lino-linoan, gause tempo iya'a i yaku' sianpo parasaya, mbaka' sian yaku' inti'i a upa men yaku' limang.
Balaki' tuu' a kaporeanna Tumpunta na ingku'. Ia ninsidakon i yaku' kada' momoko mamarasaya i Ia ka' molingu'kon mian. Barakaat men koiya'a nirookonmo gause i yaku' moto kantang tii Kristus Yesus.

Men tundunonku kani'imari mase tuutuu' ka' tio laboton bi tuu'. Tundunan iya'a koi kani'imari: Kristus Yesus notaka na tano' balaki' kani'i mase mae' mansalamatkon mian men dosaon. Ka' i yaku'mo a mian dosaon men ba'idekna na giigii' mian!

Kasee mau koiya'a, Alaata'ala nantarai i yaku' lino-linoan kada' i yaku' men dosaon tuu' kani'i sida bo pimiile'anna mian se' i Yesus Kristus sian sungkolkon i yaku'. Ka' ni'imo a men sida bo piile'onna mian ni'imarian men parasaya na Ko'ona, kada' mantausi tutuo' men pore pataka sidutu.
Alaata'ala, Tomundo' na giigii' tempo, tio angga'ion ka' pobalaki'on pataka manau', gause Ia a men sidutu, sian piile'on ka' sa'a-sa'angu'! Amin.

Timotius anakku! Palimangon kani'i posuu'kononku i koo gause minginau'kon men ia tadulkon nabii muntundun wakaam. Potuun iya'a tio inau'oon tempo i koo mampari-pari mungurungku'i upa-upa men mantalintangi kaparasaya'aan na Tumpu. Tontoni a kaparasaya'aan men kana' ka' alia mingilintuani koi men taena poluuna noaam.
Isian mian men sianmo mingimamat men taena poluuna noana, pataka kaparasaya'anna i raaya'a silaka'mo.
Mian iraaya'a tonsoop i Himeneus tii Aleksander. Rua-rua' irana yaku' rookonmo na Ibiliis bo ukumonna, kada' i raaya'a modoa mingiroki Alaata'ala.
Mbali' men tumbena tuu' pa'ase'onku na ko'oom koi kani'imari: sambayangkonoon a giigii' mian. Tadulkonoon a pa'ase'na i raaya'a, ka' uga' basukuur na Alaata'ala.
Sambayangkonoon a tomundo' ka' giigii' i'intoni kuasa. Pa'ase' kada' i kita ratong ka' rampot, ka' sinampang malolo' na Alaata'ala ka' mingilimang upa men kana'.
Ya'a a men pore ka' kokana'na Alaata'ala men Pansalamatkon i kita.
Kikira'-Na kada' giigii' mian salamatkonon ka' minginti'i men tuutuu'na.
Gause sa'a-sa'angu' a Alaata'ala ka' sa'a-sa'angu' a topobisara bo pangkantang Alaata'ala tia mian. Mian men topobisara iya'a i Kristus Yesus.
Yesus nongorookonmo waka-Na bo pontololokina giigii' mian. Koiya'a sasalanna Alaata'ala nimpipiile'kon pingkira'-Na mansalamatkon mian na tempo men koi Ia patukokonmo.

Ka' i yaku' ninakat sida pambantili ka' poposuu' kada' mae' na mian na lipu' sambana men taasi' Yahudi ka' mimisiso'kon na ko'ona i raaya'a kaparasaya'an men kana'. Men tundunonku kani'i tuutuu'. Yaku' sian mimborek.
Kikira'ku kada' mau maana, moro'one basambayang mengeleengket lima men molinas, ka' sian maso' kabai poosinsala' tia mian.

Koiya'a uga' wiwine. Kalu bapeasi, sian paraa batatamberei. Pakean men pisokonna tio koi men na aturan ka' koi men kana'. Alia mongopiir wuuk men batatamberei kabai se' mompore-porei waka tia mosoni kabai mutiara kabai pakean men alayo' a angga'na.
Kasee porena wiwine tio mompore-porei waka tia gau' men pore koi wawauna wiwine men bakitumpu.
Tempo pisiso'on wiwine tio mimporokot ka' tuutuu' momorongori.
Yaku' sian mamatalai wiwine mambantili kabai se' mangatur moro'one. Raaya'a tio mimporokot.
Gause men tumbena ia sidakon Alaata'ala mase i Adam, kasi i Hawa.
Ka' taasi'po i Adam kasee wiwine a men nokobaetok pataka i ia nangawawau dosa.
Mau koiya'a, wiwine bo salamatkonon gause i raaya'a mondompu'kon anak, kalu i raaya'a sinampang parasaya ni Kristus, ka' molingu'kon mian sambana ka' tumuo' molinas koi men kana'.
Tuutuu' a wurung men koi kani'imari: “Mian men mingkira' sida guru jama'at mingkikira'i palimangon men umangga' tuu'.”

Mbaka' mian men bo guru jama'at tio mian men sianta idekna, sa'a-sa'angu' a boroki'na, minginti'i mantaankon pingkira'na noa, motu'a a noana, ka' sian sida sambu-sambumo a wawauna. Ia tio mingkira' mangalaboti mian na laiganna, ka' minginti'i mimisiso' mian.
Sian sida mian men bukuan balio-lio' kabai se' soropu'on. Ia tio mian men pore a noana ka' sian mingkira' poogagai. Ia sian sida tongko' loingonkon doi'.
Ia tio pore a pangawawana suo'na, ka' mimisiso' anakna kada' momorongori ka' uga' mangangga'i i ia.
Gause kalu mian men sian minginti'i mangawawa suo'na, koi upa a bo pontondongna jama'atna Alaata'ala?
Mian men baasi noparasaya sian sida bo guru jama'at. Gause kalu i ia bo guru jama'at, too mba'a i ia mintidaa-daa ka' kana'onna ukuman koi Ibiliis nokana' ukuman tempo mbaripian.
Ia tio uga' mian men pore a ngaanna koi pinginti'ina mian biai' men taasi' tongko' na jama'atna, dako' i ia poposala'onna mian, ka' tonso'ol na sosoolna Ibiliis.
Papalimangna jama'at uga' tio mian men angga'ion, wawauna tio sintutu' tia porobuanna, sian sida men bukuan minginum upa kolio' ka' sian loingonkon doi'.
Mianna tio maloos a noa montontoni pisiso' men ia popo'inti'ikon Alaata'ala.
Raaya'a tio topongion kutung. Inti'ionsi se' sianta wawauna men ba'idek, kasi i raaya'a sida bo papalimangna jama'at.
Boroki'na i raaya'a uga' tio mian men angga'ion ka' sian momotaekon mian. Boroki'na tio mian men momoko mantaankon pingkira'na noa ka' sida ooskonon na giigii' upa.
Papalimangna jama'at tio sa'a-sa'angu' a boroki'na. Ia tio pore a pangawawana anakna tia suo'na.
Papalimangna jama'at men pore a balimangna bo angga'ion, ka' momoko muntundunkon na mian biai' se' i ia parasaya ni Kristus Yesus.
Kikira'ku sianmo paraa manau', yaku' mangarae'i i koo Timotius. Mau koiya'a i yaku' uga' dauga' muntulis surat kani'i bo ko'oom,

kada' kalu i yaku' tompaalin taka, inti'ioon se' koi upa a tutuo'ta koi sa'angu' poto'utusanna Alaata'ala, Alaata'ala men tumuo'. Kita jama'at-Na. Jama'atmo iya'a a men bookoi tumbak ka' bo pamakadodor pisiso'na Alaata'ala men kana'.

Sian sagiaon a pisiso' men ia popo'inti'ikon Alaata'ala: Kristus nintipiile' koi dudusna mian, ka' ia potuutuu' Alus Molinas, ka' giigii' malaa'ikat poto piile'. Lele-Na nilelekon na giigii' lipu'. Na longkop tano' balaki' isian mian men namarasaya, ka' i Ia nileengket waara'a na surugaa ka' ni'angga'i.
Poali Alus Molinas tuutuu' nambantilkonmo se' na tempo men kokomburi'anna isian mian men mansaukon kaparasaya'anna. Raaya'a mongololo' pisiso'na diim tia meena men mansala'kon.
Pisiso' iya'a bantilkononna mian men minti pa'a-pa'agama kasee borek. Noana i raaya'a sianmo minginti'i upa men kana' ka' men sala'.

Raaya'a mongkokundakon mian mosuo' ka' mangaan se' isian kakaan men doso kaanon. Men tuutuu'na Alaata'ala a ninsidakon iya'a giigii' bo labotonna mian men parasaya ka' minginti'i pisiso' men kana', kasee giigii' iya'a tiodaa sukuurkonon.
Giigii' upa men ia sidakon Alaata'ala iya'a pore, ka' sianta sa'angu'po upa men sida kokundaion kalu nilabotmo tia sukuur na Alaata'ala.
Mbali' giigii' iya'a nosidamo pore gause sambayangta ka' upa men ia bantilkon Alaata'ala.

Pisiso'kon a giigii' iya'a na utus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an. Kalu i koo sinampang mingimamat pisiso' men kana' ka' mingimamat Wurungna Alaata'ala men parasayaonta men nilolo'mo pataka koini'i, mbaka' i koo bo sida papalimang ni Kristus Yesus men balimang pore.
Alia momorongori tundunan men sian inti'ion a patukna kabai uma-umanna motu-motu'a men sianta kana'na. Koo tio mansara-sarak minginti'i malolo' na Alaata'ala.

Mansarak ugot bo kaporeanna waka tongko' titiu' a kana'na, kasee kalu mansarak minginti'i malolo' na Alaata'ala isian kana'na bona giigii' upa, gause isian ee'na bona tuo' koini'i ka' uga' tuo' ni'imarian.
Pisiso' iya'a tuutuu' ka' sida laboton bi tuu'.
Mbali' i kita mampari-pari ka' kakat balimang, gause i kita tongko' mongooskon Alaata'ala men tumuo'. Iamo a Pansalamatkon giigii' mian, ka' mian men parasaya na Ko'ona a men tuutuu' salamatkonon-Na.
Pisiso'kon a giigii' iya'a ka' posuu'kon bi lolo'onna mian.

Koo mase dauga' anak malai kasee alia isian mian men sian minsirinai i koo. Koo tio sida men bo lolo'onna giigii' mian parasaya na Tumpu, mau na tundunaan, na wawauum, na polingu'um tia simbaya'am, ka' na kaparasaya'aan ni Yesus Kristus tia tutuo'om men molinas.
Kopera-peraawan i yaku' taka, koo tio kakat mambasakon Alkitaap na mian ka' mambantili tia mimisiso' i raaya'a.
Alia i koo mandalai barakaat men ia rookon Alus Molinas na ko'oom tempo toropii penatua nansampekon lima na wawona takala'am ka' nantadulkon potuunna Alaata'ala.
Alaka' limang a giigii' iya'a tia noa men kakat, kada' kampiile'an na giigii' mian se' palimangoon ninturangmo pore.
Dagai a wakaam ka' dagai uga' a upa men pisiso'konoon. Alia kobangaran mingilimang iya'a, gause wawauum men koiya'a mansalamatkon wakaam tia mian men momorongori i koo.
Alia i koo mengerengeaki mian moro'one men motu'ana tii koo, kasee bantili i ia koi se' i ia a tamaam. Bantili a anak malai moro'one koi utuus moro'one,
ka' wiwine men motu'ana tii koo tio galaloon koi sinaam. Wiwine laandue' tio galaloon koi utuus wiwine men morio'na ka' tiodaa bantilioon tia noa men tuutuu' maloos.
Angga'i a wiwine balu men sianta poto'utusanna.

Kasee kalu wiwine balu iya'a anakon kabai se' tumpuanmo, mbaka' i raaya'a a men tio pisiso'oon se' tio mingimamat minti'ina. Raaya'a tio minginti'i mangawalos polingu'na minti'ina, gause wawau men koiya'a a men daa kokana'na Alaata'ala.
Wiwine men tuutuu' nobalumo ka' sianmo mian men bo pingimamat, ia tongko' mongooskon Alaata'ala. Ilio malom i ia sambayang miki tulung na Ko'ona.
Kasee wiwine mau nobalumo, see ka' tongko' mongololoikon pingkira'na noana, mbaka' mau i ia dauga' tumuo', ia sida ngaanon noko lapusmo.
Bantilkon a pisiso' iya'a na ko'ona i raaya'a dako' tutuo'na i raaya'a sasala'on.
Kasee kalu isian mian men sian mingimamat poto'utusanna, ka' tontuko men sangkau laigan, mbaka' mian iya'a nansaukonmo kaparasaya'anna. Ia a ba'idekna tia mian men sian parasaya.
Wiwine balu men tonsoop na kitapna jama'at tiodaa umur nomompulo' taun waara'ana, ka' sa'a-sa'angu' a langkai'na.

Ia tio tolele koi sa'angu' wiwine men mangawawau pore, koimo montondongi anakna pore-pore, mingkira' mangalaboti sawe' na laiganna ka' mimimbuu'i utus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an, mangalawei mian men marepa ka' kakat mingilimang biai' kaliangan palimangon men pore.

Mau nobalumo kasee umurna sianpo motu'a, men koiya'a alia monsoopkon na saa'na wiwine balu. Gause kalu i raaya'a dauga' mingkira'kon moro'one ka' mosuo' soosoodo, raaya'a mongkolimbo'konmo toonna ni Kristus.
Gause i raaya'a nangalusimo toonna men olukon men bona Tumpu, mbaka' i raaya'a kana'onna ukuman.
Ka' uga' i raaya'a bo sida molulu', malia' malau masawe' na laiganna mian. Ka' men ka'idek tuu' kalu i raaya'a weweron, ka' sampotan, ka' muntundun upa-upa men sian sida tundunon.

Mbali' kikira'ku kada' wiwine men balu kasee daa sianpo motu'a, bagia bi posuo' soosoodo. Raaya'a bi anakon kada' bo pontondongi laiganna, dako' mian men maso'kon i kita isian pimpu'uanna mingidek ngaanta.
Gause toropii wiwine balu nolumiasmo mongololo' Ibiliis.

Kalu sa'angu' moro'one kabai wiwine men parasaya na Tumpu isian poto'utusanna men wiwine balu, utusna moro'one kabai wiwine men parasaya iya'a tio muntulung i ia. Alia mamatalaikon jama'at a bo pangkalesang, kada' daa jama'at sida muntulung wiwine balu men tuutuu' sianta sa'angu'po a poto'utusanna.
Penatua men daa pore a limangna na jama'at tio angga'ion pinduan paku'. Ka' men tukona, raaya'a men kakat mengelelekon Wurungna Tumpu tia mimisiso' mian.
Gause na Alkitaap isian ningaan koi kani'imari: “Alia i kuu memeno' nganga'na sapi' men pintanga' umiik,” ka' uga', “Sa'angu' papalimang tio mantausi tambona.”
Aliapo' sai-sai i koo mamarasaya upa men raitkononna mian na penatua kalu sianta toro rua' kabai se' toro tolu' mian men bo pompotuutuu' i raaya'a.
Raaya'a men sinampang mangawawau dosa tio bantilioon na aropna mian biai' na jama'at kada' mian sambana bi layaon.

Pa'ase'onku tuu' na ko'oom se' na giigii' upa men limangoon koo tio mongololo' pisiso'ku kani'imari: alia mansasaaki mian ka' alia mompoosasala'kon pangaropi mian. Alaata'ala ka' i Kristus Yesus tia malaa'ikat men Ia rurukimo mimiile' i kita.
Alia i koo masasara' manganakat mian bo balimang na jama'at. Alia tonggilolo' na dosana mian sambana. Dagai uga' a waka susuung kada' sinampang molinas.
Alia tongko' minginum weer bulu-bulu'. Inum uga' a anggur toro tiu', gause kompoong sian laan pore ka' i koo malia' sian laan maka'ala.
Isian mian men dosana manasamo koo'po tia i ia taka na pungukumian. Kasee isian dosana mian sambana men komburi'si ka' ka'inti'ian.
Koiya'a uga' isian wawau men pore men daa dongan ka'inti'ian. Ka' kalu sian dongan ka'inti'ian, wawau iya'a sabole sian kawunianna pataka manau'.

Giigii' utus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an men munsuri rawatna palimangonna koi ata'na mian uga' tio minginti'i se' tanaasna tio bo angga'ionna, kada' ngaanna Alaata'ala tia pisiso' men ringkat na Ko'ona sian irokionna mian.

Kalu tanaasna iya'a mian parasaya, alia i raaya'a mansapa' montookon se' daa utus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an. Kasee i raaya'a tio mingilimang palimangon men pore tuu', gause mian men mangalabot palimangon men pore iya'a uga' koikoimo mian parasaya men kolingu'na.
Kalu isian mian mimisiso', kasee tia pisiso' sambana men taasi' koi wurungna Tumpunta i Yesus Kristus men daa kana', ka' taasi' koi pisiso'na kaparasaya'anta,

mbaka' mian iya'a kominti-minti kasee sianta titiu'po a men inti'ionna. Men pangka'idekian, ia bukuan mangawawau kogora'an ka' mompogagaikon wurung pataka mian masindir, poomaso', momotaekon mian, mansasaaki mian,
ka' poosinsala' gause pinginti'ianna i raaya'a sianmo manasa ka' sianmo minginti'i men kana'. Raaya'a mansarui se' bakitumpu iya'a sida mantakakon dale'.
Bookoi bakitumpu mase mantakakon dale' men balaki', kalu mian bangar tia upa men isian na ko'ona.
Gause i kita sian nangawawa upa-upa minsoop na tano' balaki' kani'i ka' sianta upa men daa sida wawaonta na ko'ule'konan.
Kalu isianmo kakaan tia pakean, nono' daamo.

Kasee mian men mingkira' kupangon bo mungurumpaki solon-solong, ka' kososoolian na giigii' pingkira'na noa men bobo', men mantakakon balaa'. Pingkira' men koiya'a mantakakon kobaraba'ianna ka' kokosilaka'anna.
Loingonkon doi' mase pimpu'uanna giigii' idek. Isian toropii mian men nampari-pari mansarak doi' pataka mingiliaskon kaparasaya'anna. Wawauna nengerepai waka-wakanamo ka' mantakakon kasiongo'an.

Timotius! Koo sa'angu' mianna Alaata'ala. Mbaka' giigii' men ba'idek alia mingilimang. Pari-pari ka' limang a men daa kana', bakitumpu, malolo' na Alaata'ala, pookolingu'kon, mokotaan mongololongi repaan, ka' noaam tio pore na mian.

Koo tio mampari-pari mungurungku'i upa-upa men mantalintangi kaparasaya'aan na Tumpu. Pari-pari kada' mantausi tutuo' men pore pataka sidutu. Tutuo' iya'a men ia leelo'kon Alaata'ala na ko'oom tempo i koo nompotuutuu' na mian biai' se' i koo parasaya ni Kristus.

Bantilkononku na ko'oom koi kani'imari: Alaata'ala men nantarai kotuo'an bona giigii' upa, ka' i Kristus Yesus men nuntundunkon men kana' ni Pontius Pilatus, Raaya'a a men mongorongor potoongku kani'imari:
Lolo' a giigii' upa men niposuukon iya'a. Alia mangawawau men ba'idek ka' men sala' pataka kotakaanna Tumpunta i Yesus Kristus.
Tempo kotakaan-Na iya'a, Alaata'ala men sa'a-sa'angu' a bo Pinginti'i. Tontunde' i Ia. Ia Tomundo'na giigii' tomundo' ka' Moola'na giigii' men moola'.

Tongko' i Ia a men daa sian lapus. Ia dumodongo na ruar men sian pokoon karani'on. Sianta sa'angu'po mian a men daa nimiile'mo i Ia. Ka' mian mase sian mimiile' Alaata'ala. Tontunde' a Alaata'ala tia kuasa-Na men sidutu! Amin.

Rorongikon na mian men kupangon na tano' balaki' kani'i dako' i raaya'a mintidaa-daa ka' tongko' mongooskon kupang men sian mantaan pataka manau' iya'a, kasee ooskon a Alaata'ala. Ia pontombonoi giigii' upa ka' mantarai i kita giigii' men bo kaporeanta.
Ka' uga' rorongikon kada' i raaya'a pore a wawauna ka' mongononoai mingilimang men kana', ka' mingkira' pootarai ka' poo'obos.
Mbali' i raaya'a mantambun kupang men daa sida bo ooskononna i raaya'a na tempo kani'imarian, kada' raaya'a mantausi tutuo' men tuutuu'na.
Timotius! Alaka' imamat a upa men nipokaumo na ko'oom. Alia muntundun upa men sianta kana'na, men sian molinas, ka' alia mompoogagaikon pinginti'i men mimpu'u na kumakapandean men sian kana'.
Isian toropii mian men mimisiso'kon men koiya'a. Mbali' i raaya'a notoliasmo a imaanna. Sulano kaporeanna Tumpu surioon na tutuo'om.
